base_document_status: SEALED AND UNMODIFIED. This amendment does not rewrite it. Both documents are pinned by the GO and both are re-hashed at preflight; where they disagree, this amendment governs.

why_this_amendment_exists.finding: R9 as written in the base preregistration is insufficient.
why_this_amendment_exists.reason_1: It loads the pickled optimizer state into a SEPARATE torch Adam built by the runner. That proves the file is loadable. It does not prove that the moments are present in the LIVE optimizer that the real algo.restore_from_path created inside the learner.
why_this_amendment_exists.reason_2: It compares shapes and the step counter only. It does not compare the bytes of exp_avg and exp_avg_sq, nor the param_groups.
why_this_amendment_exists.consequence: A restore that silently produced a fresh optimizer with correctly shaped but numerically wrong moments would have passed R9. That is the same class of silent failure as the inference_only export leaving a fresh critic, which is the defect this whole line of work exists to rule out.
why_this_amendment_exists.resolution: R9 is replaced by a LIVE, in-process, byte-exact comparison. The hermetic check is kept, extended to byte identity, and demoted to an independent second opinion under a new gate R13.

gate_count.change: R9 is redefined and R13 is added. R1-R8 and R10-R12 are unchanged from the base document.

R9_superseded.label: R9_live_optimizer_is_byte_exact_after_restore
R9_superseded.supersedes: R9_optimizer_really_restorable of the base document, in full
R9_superseded.where_it_runs: inside the production child process, at the exact instant after algo.restore_from_path(resume_path) returns
R9_superseded.how_the_instant_is_reached: train_ppo_mlp.py:1741-1748 calls _reapply_optimizer_learning_rate(algo, args.lr) on the line immediately after the restore, and appends its result to optimizer_lr_audit under stage 'after_restore'. A validation-only wrapper replaces that module attribute in the child process, calls the ORIGINAL first, and captures the live optimizer immediately afterwards.
R9_superseded.capture_path: train_ppo_mlp._learner_call_results(algo, capture) -> algo.learner_group.foreach_learner(capture); capture(learner) iterates learner.get_optimizers_for_module('default_policy'). This is the same traversal the production code itself uses, not a reimplementation of it.
R9_superseded.what_is_compared: the live optimizer.state_dict() against checkpoint_last/learner_group/learner/state.pkl -> optimizer['default_policy_default_optimizer']['state'], recursively and exactly
comparison_covers: the set of top-level keys: exactly {'param_groups', 'state'} on both sides
every param_groups entry: every key, every primitive value, and the params index list
the set of state keys: exactly the six integers 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 on both sides
for every one of those six entries: every key, and the BYTES of exp_avg and exp_avg_sq
the step counter of every entry
R9_superseded.on_mismatch: the wrapper raises. run() catches it into stop_reason 'error' and ok false, main() then raises SystemExit(1), so the child returncode is 1 and the production run is a FAILURE. The audit cannot pass by silently recording a discrepancy.
R9_superseded.verdict_predicate: the live audit evidence file exists, reports exact true, reports zero differences, names exactly one learner and exactly one optimizer, and summary.optimizer_lr_audit holds an entry whose stage is 'after_restore'

normalisation.why_it_is_needed: the source is a pickle of NumPy arrays and Python scalars; the live optimizer holds torch tensors. Comparing the raw objects would fail on representation rather than on content, so both sides are mapped to one canonical form and only then compared with ==.

measured_source_types.param_groups[0]['params']: Python list of the twelve ints 0..11
measured_source_types.param_groups[0] other keys: amsgrad, capturable, decoupled_weight_decay, differentiable, maximize as bool; eps and lr as float; weight_decay as int; foreach and fused as None

rules.tensor_like_with_ndim_ge_1: ('tensor', dtype string with any 'torch.' prefix stripped, shape tuple, sha256 of the C-order bytes). This is where byte identity of exp_avg and exp_avg_sq is enforced.
rules.tensor_like_with_ndim_0_and_numeric_scal: ('scalar', the exact Python value). A zero-dimensional float32 tensor holding 81.0 and a Python float 81.0 both normalise to ('scalar', 81.0). No tolerance is applied; the comparison is ==.
rules.bool: ('prim', 'bool', value) - checked BEFORE int, because bool is a subclass of int
rules.list_and_tuple: ('seq', [normalised items]) - a tuple and a list with the same contents normalise equal, which is required because betas survives the round trip as either
rules.dict: ('map', sorted list of (normalised key, normalised value)) - integer keys stay integers
rules.anything_else: ('opaque', type name) - and an opaque value on either side is itself recorded as a difference, so an unrecognised type fails closed rather than passing silently

normalisation.declared_consequence_of_calling_the_orig: the architect requires the original _reapply_optimizer_learning_rate to run before the capture. It sets param_groups lr to args.lr. Both the checkpoint and this stage use lr 1e-4, so the write is numerically a no-op; had they differed, the lr comparison would fail and the gate would correctly report it. This is declared rather than concealed.

R13_added.label: R13_hermetic_second_opinion_with_byte_identity
R13_added.role: independent verification, out of process, with no Ray, no environment and no production wrapper
R13_added.what_it_does: the runner builds one AsymmetricActorCriticTorchRLModule at the pinned geometry, loads the sixteen-key module_state with strict=True, rebuilds a torch Adam over the twelve parameters in named_parameters() order, converts the pickled optimizer state to tensors and calls load_state_dict
R13_added.extended_beyond_the_base_document: it now also requires that exp_avg and exp_avg_sq of all six entries be BYTE-identical to the source arrays, not merely shape-compatible
R13_added.what_it_additionally_establishes: that named_parameters() indices 0..5 are exactly the six actor tensors and indices 6..11 are exactly the six critic tensors, which upgrades 'six Adam entries at indices [6..11]' from a positional claim to an identified one
R13_added.independence: it must agree with R9. R9 measures the live optimizer inside production; R13 measures the file from outside. Two disagreeing methods fail the stage.

the_command_amended.base_document_declared: three operations on sealed_command(): substitute the config, remove the five warm-start tokens, append --resume-from

fourth_operation_added.why: the live capture of R9 has to exist inside the child process before run() reaches the restore. There is no way to install it from outside the process.

the_command_amended.wrapper_own_arguments: the wrapper consumes its own arguments before a literal '--' separator and passes everything after it to train_ppo_mlp unchanged: --audit-source-state <path to the source learner state.pkl> --audit-evidence <path to the evidence file> -- <the twenty tokens minus interpreter and script>
the_command_amended.note_on_counting: the twenty-token count refers to the train_ppo_mlp argv the wrapper delegates. The full child argv is longer by the wrapper's own arguments and the separator, and both forms are recorded in the receipt.

the_wrapper.modifies_no_production_file: it rebinds one attribute of the imported train_ppo_mlp module inside this child process only. No file under baseline_MLP is written, and the constraint 'no production modification if avoidable' is satisfied because there is no way to observe the live optimizer from outside the process.
the_wrapper.it_does_not_emulate: after installing the wrap it sets sys.argv and calls train_ppo_mlp.main(), which reaches run() and algo.restore_from_path. It never reimplements the restore, never constructs its own Algorithm and never bypasses parse_args.
the_wrap_contract: the original function is called FIRST and its return value is returned unchanged to production
the capture happens immediately after the original returns and before control goes back to run()
the wrap is installed exactly once and asserts that the attribute it replaces is the original function
on any mismatch it raises; it never downgrades a mismatch to a warning
if the wrapped function is never called, no evidence file is written and R9 fails closed
